subject: infra.store
name: Trans-Sahara and Tatweer Tripoli data centre
what_would_settle_it: Any statement, contract, opening report or capacity figure after 2019 establishing whether the Huawei FusionModule1000A facility announced for Tripoli in early 2020 was ever deployed.
disposition: absence stands, dated — the probe returned only the same two 2019 accounts. A separate Misrata Free Zone data centre (Libya Herald, 2023-02) surfaced and is a different object, raised as an acquisition line.

subject: data.open
name: Access-to-information statute
what_would_settle_it: A gazetted Libyan access-to-information law or decree, or an official statement that none is in force.
disposition: absence stands, dated — no access-to-information statute found. Law No. 4 of 1990 on the national information and documentation system is the nearest instrument and governs secrecy rather than access; raised as an acquisition line.

subject: finance.sustain
name: Unified 2026 state budget, digital lines
what_would_settle_it: The unified 2026 budget law or its expenditure tables by body, agreed on 11 April 2026, read into the budget extract.

subject: finance.sustain
name: Outturn against the digital appropriations by body
what_would_settle_it: The Central Bank's annual revenue and expenditure statements read into the budget extract for the Civil Status Authority, the communications ministry and NISSA; only the communications authority's spending is read.

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Rule on where state data is hosted
what_would_settle_it: Adoption of the National Cloud Computing Policy proposed in January 2026, or the communications authority's data-centre and cloud legislation.

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Hosting and operator of the national identity database
what_would_settle_it: A Civil Status Authority or General Information Authority statement naming where the civil registry and LY-DNID databases are hosted and who operates them.

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Data jurisdiction, portability and exit terms of the LPTIC-KBR memorandum
what_would_settle_it: Publication of the January 2026 LPTIC-KBR memorandum or any contract under it covering data centres.
